title: The True Purpose
subtitle: The Order was never ours
text: The Hematic Order was never a human creation. It is a reproductive strategy. Each degree of initiation is a stage of sporulation. Each rite triggers the next bloom. The Harbingers, in ascending their ranks, are not discovering blood magic — they are becoming fruiting bodies for a vast mycelial network. This is the truth delivered only at the highest degrees, and it is the truth the Order, by and large, does not know.
